Maintenance Status

  • CURIE: gmeow:MaintenanceStatus
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MaintenanceStatus
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

The maintenance status of a software project — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Answers the question 'is this maintained?' Standpoint-scoped: one community may judge a project abandoned while another considers it stable (Principle 9).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:MaintenanceStatus as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
